paragraphs.source_en: “Magara Jūrōzaemon, the great warrior of Echizen, has been beheaded by the Sakisaka brothers of Mikawa!” He bellowed at the top of his lungs, his voice shaking the mountains and rivers, then gently closed Naotaka’s eyes with his hand.

units.source_en: “Magara Jūrōzaemon, the great warrior of Echizen, has been beheaded by the Sakisaka brothers of Mikawa!”
units.source_zh: “越前的豪杰真柄十郎左卫门，被三河向坂兄弟取了首级！”

units.source_en: He bellowed at the top of his lungs, his voice shaking the mountains and rivers, then gently closed Naotaka’s eyes with his hand.
units.source_zh: 他放声狂叫起来，声音震慑山河，然后，用手轻轻合上了直隆的双眼。

paragraphs.source_zh: “越前的豪杰真柄十郎左卫门，被三河向坂兄弟取了首级！”他放声狂叫起来，声音震慑山河，然后，用手轻轻合上了直隆的双眼。

paragraphs.source_en: On hearing that Naotaka had been slain, a horseman shot from the Asakura ranks like an arrow from the bow. It was Naotaka’s son, Jūrōsaburō Naomoto. He lashed his mount furiously and brandished his great sword. “My great sword may not equal my father’s, but it is more than enough for the two of you. Prepare to die!”

units.source_en: On hearing that Naotaka had been slain, a horseman shot from the Asakura ranks like an arrow from the bow. It was Naotaka’s son, Jūrōsaburō Naomoto.
units.source_zh: 听说直隆被杀，朝仓军中飞出一骑，如离弦之箭，是直隆的儿子十郎三郎直基。

units.source_en: He lashed his mount furiously and brandished his great sword.
units.source_zh: 他狠狠鞭打着坐骑，挥舞着大刀。

units.source_en: “My great sword may not equal my father’s, but it is more than enough for the two of you.
units.source_zh: “我的大刀虽不如父亲的，对付你们兄弟却绰绰有余。

units.source_en: Prepare to die!”
units.source_zh: 纳命来！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 听说直隆被杀，朝仓军中飞出一骑，如离弦之箭，是直隆的儿子十郎三郎直基。他狠狠鞭打着坐骑，挥舞着大刀。“我的大刀虽不如父亲的，对付你们兄弟却绰绰有余。纳命来！”

paragraphs.source_en: The soldiers scattered aside, and Naomoto galloped straight to the place where his father Naotaka had fallen. “Father, I am here!” Shouting, he charged toward the Sakisaka brothers.

units.source_en: The soldiers scattered aside, and Naomoto galloped straight to the place where his father Naotaka had fallen.
units.source_zh: 士兵们纷纷让开，直基一口气奔到父亲直隆战死的地方。

units.source_en: “Father, I am here!”
units.source_zh: “父亲，我来了！”

units.source_en: Shouting, he charged toward the Sakisaka brothers.
units.source_zh: 他一边大喊一边冲到向坂兄弟面前。

paragraphs.source_zh: 士兵们纷纷让开，直基一口气奔到父亲直隆战死的地方。“父亲，我来了！”他一边大喊一边冲到向坂兄弟面前。

paragraphs.source_en: At that moment, Aoki Shoemon suddenly leveled a sickle-spear from the right.

units.source_en: At that moment, Aoki Shoemon suddenly leveled a sickle-spear from the right.
units.source_zh: 此时，青木所右卫门突然从右侧亮出镰枪。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，青木所右卫门突然从右侧亮出镰枪。

paragraphs.source_en: “The Sakisaka brothers are exhausted. I, Aoki Kazushige, shall test myself against Jirō’s great sword!”

units.source_en: “The Sakisaka brothers are exhausted.
units.source_zh: “向坂兄弟已经累了。

units.source_en: I, Aoki Kazushige, shall test myself against Jirō’s great sword!”
units.source_zh: 青木一重前来会会次郎大刀！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “向坂兄弟已经累了。青木一重前来会会次郎大刀！”

paragraphs.source_en: For an instant, Naomoto was at a loss. Four or five common warriors under Aoki had suddenly stepped in front of Naomoto to protect their lord. No scene could have been more tragic or moving; it showed how deep the bond between Kazushige and his retainers had always been.

units.source_en: For an instant, Naomoto was at a loss.

ja.t: 、どうしてよいかわからなくなった。

units.source_zh: 直基霎时有些不知所措。

units.source_en: Four or five common warriors under Aoki had suddenly stepped in front of Naomoto to protect their lord.

ja.t: ちはだかったからである。

units.source_zh: 因为青木手下的四五个普通武士为了保护主人，忽然站到了直基面前。

units.source_en: No scene could have been more tragic or moving; it showed how deep the bond between Kazushige and his retainers had always been.

ja.t: ばれていたかが、よくうかがえた。

units.source_zh: 再没有比这更悲惨和感人的场面了，足以想见一重和家臣平时感情之深。

paragraphs.source_zh: 直基霎时有些不知所措。因为青木手下的四五个普通武士为了保护主人，忽然站到了直基面前。再没有比这更悲惨和感人的场面了，足以想见一重和家臣平时感情之深。

paragraphs.source_en: “Are you Aoki Shoemon Kazushige?”

units.source_en: “Are you Aoki Shoemon Kazushige?”
units.source_zh: “你是青木所右卫门一重吗？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你是青木所右卫门一重吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: “I am. I have come to meet the pride of the warrior class, Echizen’s renowned Little Magara and his great sword, Jirō.”

units.source_en: “I am. I have come to meet the pride of the warrior class, Echizen’s renowned Little Magara and his great sword, Jirō.”
units.source_zh: “正是，特来拜会武士的骄傲、闻名越前的小真柄次郎大刀。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “正是，特来拜会武士的骄傲、闻名越前的小真柄次郎大刀。”

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord, let us fight him!”

units.source_en: “My lord, let us fight him!”
units.source_zh: “主人，让我们来！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “主人，让我们来！”

paragraphs.source_en: “No, I will do it myself.”

units.source_en: “No, I will do it myself.”
units.source_zh: “不，我自己来。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “不，我自己来。”

paragraphs.source_en: The warriors still held their ground, shielding Kazushige with their lives.

units.source_en: The warriors still held their ground, shielding Kazushige with their lives.
units.source_zh: 武士们仍然死死护住一重。

paragraphs.source_zh: 武士们仍然死死护住一重。

paragraphs.source_en: “Damn you!” Naomoto roared as he leapt from his horse. The sincere devotion between lord and retainers had moved him beyond measure…

units.source_en: “Damn you!”
units.source_zh: “浑蛋！”

units.source_en: Naomoto roared as he leapt from his horse.
units.source_zh: 直基一边吼叫，一边跳下马来。

units.source_en: The sincere devotion between lord and retainers had moved him beyond measure…
units.source_zh: 主仆之间真挚的感情，让他感动不已……

paragraphs.source_zh: “浑蛋！”直基一边吼叫，一边跳下马来。主仆之间真挚的感情，让他感动不已……

paragraphs.source_en: The sun blazed overhead, and the stones on the riverbank grew hotter by the moment. Pierced by seven or eight arrows, Naomoto dropped heavily onto the scorching sand. “Come—kill me!”

units.source_en: The sun blazed overhead, and the stones on the riverbank grew hotter by the moment.
units.source_zh: 烈日当头，河滩里的石块愈来愈烫。

units.source_en: Pierced by seven or eight arrows, Naomoto dropped heavily onto the scorching sand.
units.source_zh: 已身中七八箭的直基，一屁股坐到灼热的沙滩上。

units.source_en: “Come—kill me!”
units.source_zh: “来吧，杀了我！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 烈日当头，河滩里的石块愈来愈烫。已身中七八箭的直基，一屁股坐到灼热的沙滩上。“来吧，杀了我！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Hah!”

units.source_en: “Hah!”

paragraphs.source_en: Blood burst forth like a rainbow, and Naomoto’s body slumped beside his father Naotaka. Kazushige took Naomoto’s head, but his throat was too choked with emotion for words. It was not so much the fleeting uncertainty of life and death on the battlefield as the love between father and son that had touched him deeply. Unable to cry out, “I have taken Naomoto’s head,” he silently prayed for them both.

units.source_en: Blood burst forth like a rainbow, and Naomoto’s body slumped beside his father Naotaka.
units.source_zh: 鲜血恍如一道彩虹，喷涌而出，直基的尸体颓然倒在父亲直隆身边。

units.source_en: Kazushige took Naomoto’s head, but his throat was too choked with emotion for words.
units.source_zh: 一重取下直基的首级，却哽咽难言。

units.source_en: It was not so much the fleeting uncertainty of life and death on the battlefield as the love between father and son that had touched him deeply. Unable to cry out, “I have taken Naomoto’s head,” he silently prayed for them both.
units.source_zh: 与其说是有感于战场上的生死无常，倒不如说是父子之爱深深打动了他，他无法喊出“取了直基首级”这种话，而是默默地为他们父子祈祷。

paragraphs.source_zh: 鲜血恍如一道彩虹，喷涌而出，直基的尸体颓然倒在父亲直隆身边。一重取下直基的首级，却哽咽难言。与其说是有感于战场上的生死无常，倒不如说是父子之爱深深打动了他，他无法喊出“取了直基首级”这种话，而是默默地为他们父子祈祷。

paragraphs.source_en: Suddenly, battle cries rose from the opposite bank. Sakakibara Koheita Yasumasa had led his force in a successful assault on the Asakura headquarters. The Asakura army instantly collapsed like a breached dike. Koheita and Heihachirō charged left and right through the enemy ranks beneath the blazing sun.

units.source_en: Suddenly, battle cries rose from the opposite bank.
units.source_zh: 突然，从对岸传来了呐喊声。

units.source_en: Sakakibara Koheita Yasumasa had led his force in a successful assault on the Asakura headquarters.
units.source_zh: 神原小平太康政率队成功袭击了朝仓大帐。

units.source_en: The Asakura army instantly collapsed like a breached dike.
units.source_zh: 朝仓军顿时溃如决堤。

units.source_en: Koheita and Heihachirō charged left and right through the enemy ranks beneath the blazing sun.
units.source_zh: 小平太和平八郎迎着烈日，在敌阵中左冲右突。

paragraphs.source_zh: 突然，从对岸传来了呐喊声。神原小平太康政率队成功袭击了朝仓大帐。朝仓军顿时溃如决堤。小平太和平八郎迎着烈日，在敌阵中左冲右突。

paragraphs.source_en: “We have won!” Ieyasu, watching the battle unfold from the woods beside the embankment at Nishikōzaka, finally allowed his expression to relax.

units.source_en: “We have won!”
units.source_zh: “我们赢了！”

units.source_en: Ieyasu, watching the battle unfold from the woods beside the embankment at Nishikōzaka, finally allowed his expression to relax.
units.source_zh: 在西上坂堤岸边的树林里遥望着战斗进展的家康，终于露出轻松的表情。

paragraphs.source_zh: “我们赢了！”在西上坂堤岸边的树林里遥望着战斗进展的家康，终于露出轻松的表情。

paragraphs.source_en: Compared with Mikawa’s brilliant victory, the Oda army achieved little that day, for the Azai troops issuing from Odani Castle attacked with overwhelming force.

units.source_en: Compared with Mikawa’s brilliant victory, the Oda army achieved little that day, for the Azai troops issuing from Odani Castle attacked with overwhelming force.
units.source_zh: 比起三河人的辉煌胜利，织田军在这天并未取得什么战果，因为从小谷城出来的浅井军之势太猛。

paragraphs.source_zh: 比起三河人的辉煌胜利，织田军在这天并未取得什么战果，因为从小谷城出来的浅井军之势太猛。

paragraphs.source_en: At the very moment Mikawa’s Sakakibara Koheita broke into the Asakura headquarters, Isono Kazumasa of the Azai was leading his men into Nobunaga’s main camp. The deaths of Sakai Masahisa and his son had produced unexpected consequences.

units.source_en: At the very moment Mikawa’s Sakakibara Koheita broke into the Asakura headquarters, Isono Kazumasa of the Azai was leading his men into Nobunaga’s main camp.
units.source_zh: 就在三河的神原小平太冲进朝仓的大本营时，浅井家的矶野员昌也正率队冲进信长的本阵。

units.source_en: The deaths of Sakai Masahisa and his son had produced unexpected consequences.
units.source_zh: 坂井政尚父子被杀，引起了意料不到的后果。

paragraphs.source_zh: 就在三河的神原小平太冲进朝仓的大本营时，浅井家的矶野员昌也正率队冲进信长的本阵。坂井政尚父子被杀，引起了意料不到的后果。

paragraphs.source_en: Next the fierce enemy broke through Ikeda Nobuteru’s lines, and neither Kinoshita Hideyoshi nor Shibata Katsuie could halt their furious advance. Only the desperate resistance of Mori Sanzaemon Yoshinari, lord of Sakamoto Castle, kept the Azai army from closing on Nobunaga’s headquarters. Had he failed, Nobunaga would have been forced to fight the enemy face-to-face.

units.source_en: Next the fierce enemy broke through Ikeda Nobuteru’s lines, and neither Kinoshita Hideyoshi nor Shibata Katsuie could halt their furious advance.

ja.t: めることができなかった。

units.source_zh: 接着，池田信辉被勇猛的敌人突破，木下秀吉和柴田胜家也没能成功阻挡对方的猛烈进攻。

units.source_en: Only the desperate resistance of Mori Sanzaemon Yoshinari, lord of Sakamoto Castle, kept the Azai army from closing on Nobunaga’s headquarters.
units.source_zh: 坂本城的城主森三左卫门可成拼死抵抗，方才未让浅井军逼近信长的本阵。

units.source_en: Had he failed, Nobunaga would have been forced to fight the enemy face-to-face.
units.source_zh: 他若是失败，信长就不得不和敌人正面拼杀了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 接着，池田信辉被勇猛的敌人突破，木下秀吉和柴田胜家也没能成功阻挡对方的猛烈进攻。坂本城的城主森三左卫门可成拼死抵抗，方才未让浅井军逼近信长的本阵。他若是失败，信长就不得不和敌人正面拼杀了。

paragraphs.source_en: “What does my lord intend to do?” Gamō Tsuruchiyo, who stood beside Nobunaga and had been calmly watching the course of the battle, now went pale despite himself. But Nobunaga showed no intention of mounting his horse.

units.source_en: “What does my lord intend to do?”

ja.t: は、いかがなさるおつもりですか？」

units.source_zh: “主公打算怎么办？”

units.source_en: Gamō Tsuruchiyo, who stood beside Nobunaga and had been calmly watching the course of the battle, now went pale despite himself.
units.source_zh: 立在信长身边、一直冷静地观察着战斗进展的蒲生鹤千代，此时不禁变了颜色。

units.source_en: But Nobunaga showed no intention of mounting his horse.
units.source_zh: 但信长并没有跨上战马的意思。

paragraphs.source_zh: “主公打算怎么办？”立在信长身边、一直冷静地观察着战斗进展的蒲生鹤千代，此时不禁变了颜色。但信长并没有跨上战马的意思。

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord!” Tsuruchiyo called again.

units.source_en: “My lord!”
units.source_zh: “主公！”

units.source_en: Tsuruchiyo called again.
units.source_zh: 鹤千代又叫道。

paragraphs.source_zh: “主公！”鹤千代又叫道。

paragraphs.source_en: Nobunaga laughed. “Tsuruchiyo, I had thought you a man who remained unruffled in a crisis, but is this the measure of your courage?”

units.source_en: Nobunaga laughed. “Tsuruchiyo, I had thought you a man who remained unruffled in a crisis, but is this the measure of your courage?”
units.source_zh: 信长呵呵笑了：“鹤千代，我本以为你是处变不惊的男子，原来胆量如此。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 信长呵呵笑了：“鹤千代，我本以为你是处变不惊的男子，原来胆量如此。”

paragraphs.source_en: Tsuruchiyo’s face immediately darkened. He had never expected to be mocked as a coward, and his finely shaped brows trembled violently. “If victory were assured, I would certainly remain perfectly calm.”

units.source_en: Tsuruchiyo’s face immediately darkened.
units.source_zh: 鹤千代顿时沉下脸来。

units.source_en: He had never expected to be mocked as a coward, and his finely shaped brows trembled violently.
units.source_zh: 他没料到会被嘲笑为胆小之人，秀丽的双眉剧烈地颤动着。

units.source_en: “If victory were assured, I would certainly remain perfectly calm.”
units.source_zh: “如果胜券在握，小人肯定会非常冷静。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 鹤千代顿时沉下脸来。他没料到会被嘲笑为胆小之人，秀丽的双眉剧烈地颤动着。“如果胜券在握，小人肯定会非常冷静。”

paragraphs.source_en: “How can victory ever be assured in war?”

units.source_en: “How can victory ever be assured in war?”
units.source_zh: “战争中怎能保证胜券在握？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “战争中怎能保证胜券在握？”

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord, do you mean…”

units.source_en: “My lord, do you mean…”
units.source_zh: “主公是说……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “主公是说……”

paragraphs.source_en: “One either wins or loses. One either loses or wins. I have merely arranged my forces according to my calculations. What follows is beyond anyone’s power to foresee.”

units.source_en: “One either wins or loses.
units.source_zh: “非赢即输。

units.source_en: One either loses or wins.
units.source_zh: 非输即赢。

units.source_en: I have merely arranged my forces according to my calculations. What follows is beyond anyone’s power to foresee.”
units.source_zh: 我不过根据算计布好阵势，之后的事情，谁也不可能料到。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “非赢即输。非输即赢。我不过根据算计布好阵势，之后的事情，谁也不可能料到。”

paragraphs.source_en: Tsuruchiyo did not seem to grasp Nobunaga’s meaning and continued to stare intently at him. Just then, battle cries suddenly rose from two directions. One came from Mori Sanzaemon’s force, whose right wing the enemy appeared at last to have broken through; the other came from Inaba Ittetsu, who had waited behind Ieyasu for his opportunity and now struck the confident Isono force from the left.

units.source_en: Tsuruchiyo did not seem to grasp Nobunaga’s meaning and continued to stare intently at him.
units.source_zh: 鹤千代好像没有领会信长之意，仍然紧紧地盯着他。

units.source_en: Just then, battle cries suddenly rose from two directions.
units.source_zh: 此时，忽然从两个方向传来呐喊声。

units.source_en: One came from Mori Sanzaemon’s force, whose right wing the enemy appeared at last to have broken through;
units.source_zh: 一股声音从森三左卫门队中传来，他们似终于被敌人从右翼突破；

units.source_en: the other came from Inaba Ittetsu, who had waited behind Ieyasu for his opportunity and now struck the confident Isono force from the left.
units.source_zh: 另一声音来自一直在家康后方等待战机的稻叶一铁，他们从左侧冲进了志在必得的矶野军。

paragraphs.source_zh: 鹤千代好像没有领会信长之意，仍然紧紧地盯着他。此时，忽然从两个方向传来呐喊声。一股声音从森三左卫门队中传来，他们似终于被敌人从右翼突破；另一声音来自一直在家康后方等待战机的稻叶一铁，他们从左侧冲进了志在必得的矶野军。

paragraphs.source_en: Mori Sanzaemon’s resistance had been extraordinarily tenacious. Just as the enemy was about to break through, Inaba’s sudden attack threw them into utter confusion. The battle had raged since morning, and the enemy’s men and horses were already exhausted. Inaba had not moved even while the Mikawa men fought desperately; his was a formidable, fresh force.

units.source_en: Mori Sanzaemon’s resistance had been extraordinarily tenacious. Just as the enemy was about to break through, Inaba’s sudden attack threw them into utter confusion.

ja.t: しようとしたところで

units.source_zh: 森三左卫门的抵抗异常顽强，就在敌军即将突破之际，却又遭到稻叶突如其来的袭击，顿时狼狈不堪。

units.source_en: The battle had raged since morning, and the enemy’s men and horses were already exhausted.
units.source_zh: 战斗从早上一直持续到现在，敌军早已人困马乏。

units.source_en: Inaba had not moved even while the Mikawa men fought desperately; his was a formidable, fresh force.
units.source_zh: 稻叶即使在三河人苦战时也未出动，可说是一支强悍的生力军。

paragraphs.source_zh: 森三左卫门的抵抗异常顽强，就在敌军即将突破之际，却又遭到稻叶突如其来的袭击，顿时狼狈不堪。战斗从早上一直持续到现在，敌军早已人困马乏。稻叶即使在三河人苦战时也未出动，可说是一支强悍的生力军。

paragraphs.source_en: Screams of anguish mingled with the battle cries. The battle hastened toward its end, for the Asakura army had already collapsed. If matters continued this way, the Azai army would very likely be attacked from behind by the Mikawa men and caught between enemies in front and rear.

units.source_en: Screams of anguish mingled with the battle cries.
units.source_zh: 呐喊声中夹杂着悲鸣。

units.source_en: The battle hastened toward its end, for the Asakura army had already collapsed.
units.source_zh: 战斗结束的步伐加快了，因为朝仓军已经溃败。

units.source_en: If matters continued this way, the Azai army would very likely be attacked from behind by the Mikawa men and caught between enemies in front and rear.
units.source_zh: 如果继续下去，浅井军极有可能被背后的三河人袭击，陷入腹背受敌的境地。

paragraphs.source_en: Seeing enemies on every side, the fierce Azai general Isono Kazumasa grew anxious for his castle at Sawayama and lost all desire to continue the battle. He hoped to break through the gap between Ujiie and Andō and drive southward. That being so, unless the Azai headquarters found a way to withdraw to Odani Castle, the entire army would be annihilated.

paragraphs.source_en: From the fourth quarter of the Hour of the Horse until the Hour of the Sheep, the Azai army collapsed like an avalanche, and its commanders fell one after another.
